data.one_liner: A dialog UI kit featuring info, confirmation, and custom dialogs with multiple variants and animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides pre-styled dialog components like info, confirmation, and custom dialogs. Includes multiple variants (success, normal, warning, error, custom) and supports various built-in enter animations.
use_when: You need pre-styled info or confirmation dialogs with icons and status colors.
You want configurable built-in animations for showing dialogs.
You need a custom dialog widget with predefined spacing and list of children.
avoid_when: You need fully bespoke dialog layouts that deviate heavily from the package design system.
You prefer pure Material Design AlertDialogs without external styling.
strengths: Includes multiple pre-built dialog variants for status types (success, error, warning, normal).
Provides built-in directional slide, fade, grow, and shrink animations.
Supports custom colors, images, and custom children layouts.
weaknesses: Relies on static show methods rather than declarative widget trees.
